fields.cover_headline:
Nothing to sell?
{o:3 questions} say otherwise.
fields.step1_body:
You've done it so long it feels like nothing.
So you don't see it. Other people do.
These 3 questions come from my free Skill Finder.
The first one is the easiest.
fields.step2_body:
What did coworkers walk over to your desk for?
Fixing the schedule? Calming upset clients?
Write down every one, even the small ones.
Then look outside work.
fields.step3_body:
Ever thought "why is this so hard for them?"
That thought is a price tag in disguise.
People pay for what feels hard to them.
But the last question is the real test.
fields.step4_body:
A favor someone offered money for.
A neighbor who said "let me pay you."
That's someone telling you the price.
Answer all 12 and AI ranks your top 3.
fields.cta_subtext: Comment {o:SKILLS} and I'll DM you my free Skill Finder: 12 questions, then AI names your 3 most sellable skills.
